items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Robert Harris, who is a teacher of the person in question, but does not claim any direct personal interaction with Van Cliburn.

ctx.x: You see, that's something else. Now, I'm going to play classical music, I'm sure, before I die, because ever since a little kid I wanted to do that. But I'm so involved with this and these other things that I like about jazz, see. I'm going to write some classical things and play them. The greatest concert pianist, Robert Harris - I don't think you met him but he's usually at my parties - he teaches over at Juilliard and if you ever want to know the piano and learn how to play the piano, get to him. I hurt my…
Van Cliburn, yes, and so he is sensational in teaching.
